description_en: Modifies the lake cache size of an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
description_zh: 修改集群湖存储加速缓存空间大小
kebab_example: aliyun adb modify-lake-cache-size --db-cluster-id amv-bp10yt0gva71ei7d --enable-lake-cache true --capacity 100 --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyLakeCacheSize

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看目标地域下所有AnalyticDB MySQL集群的详情，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the lake cache feature.

Valid values:

true
false
parameters.name: enable_lake_cache

parameters.help_en: The lake cache size that you want to set. Unit: GB
parameters.help_zh: 缓存空间大小设置，单位为GB
parameters.name: capacity
